ja335:1.1: Brahā pavaddhakāyo so dīghadāṭho hi jambuka, na tvaṃ tamhi kule jāto yattha gaṇhanti kuñjaran ti.
ja335:2.1: Asīho sīhamānena yo attānaṃ vikubbati kutthuṃ va gajam āsajja seti bhumyā anutthunaṃ.
ja335:3.1: Yasassino uttamapuggalassa sañjātakkhandhassa mahabbalassa asamekkhiya thāmabalūpapattiṃ sa seti nāgena hato va jambuko.
ja335:4.1: Yo c' īdha kammaṃ kurute pamāya thāmabalaṃ attani saṃviditvā japena mantena subhāsitena parikkhavā so vipulaṃ jinātīti.
